retraction.reason: Retracted in M42 batch 15 under brief §1: the record earns no honest edge. The English article, at revision 1369056589, is eight kilobytes and argues the treaty out of two instruments this atlas does not hold — the Eulsa Treaty of 1905, under which "the Korean Empire had become a protectorate of Japan", and the Hague Secret Emissary Affair, after which "on July 18, 1907, Japan made Emperor Gojong abdicate in favor of his son Sunjong" — and forward to the Japan–Korea Treaty of 1910. It names no event this corpus has; the Russo-Japanese war, which this atlas does hold and which every history puts behind the 1905 protectorate, is not mentioned in the article at all. It waits on the Eulsa Treaty of 1905.

title: Japan–Korea Treaty of 1907
summary: Wikidata item Q713917, imported by tools/import/wikidata.mjs. The item's own description reads "1907 unequal treaty between the Empire of Japan and the Korean Empire regarding the surrender of military and judicial power under the Japanese control". Everything here is copied from the item's own fields and nothing in it is this atlas's account of the thing: that is still to be written, and review.html is where somebody writes it.
